ccc_local_wheat.title: Grain for the Storehouse
ccc_local_wheat.body: The public bins are running low after a busy stretch of trade. Bring in a proper sack of clean wheat so the village has something put away for the next bad week.

ccc_local_logs.title: Timber for Repairs
ccc_local_logs.body: Fences, roofs, carts, and animal pens all need attention at once. The carpenter is buying a useful load of sound timber rather than waiting for the next wall to fail.

ccc_local_wool.title: Wool for the Loom
ccc_local_wool.body: The loom-house has orders waiting and almost nothing left on the rack. Bring a real bundle of clean wool so the weaver can finish blankets, cloth, and travel wraps.

ccc_local_string.title: Cord and Canvas
ccc_local_string.body: Sacks, harness, and awnings have all eaten through the repair stock. The caravan crew wants enough string to rebuild the next set properly.

ccc_local_zombie.title: Keep the Road Clear
ccc_local_zombie.body: Travelers have been turning back after dusk because the road is no longer staying quiet. Thin out the dead around the approaches before somebody gets stranded outside the village.

ccc_local_skeleton.title: Arrows in the Dark
ccc_local_skeleton.body: Fresh arrows keep appearing in fences and roadside trees after sunset. The watch wants the archers behind them dealt with before the next night patrol goes out.

ccc_local_spider.title: Webs Near the Fields
ccc_local_spider.body: Webs are spreading along the field edge and livestock paths. Clear enough spiders that animals and farmhands can use the route again without walking into a nest.

ccc_north_h1_outfitters_order.title: The Outfitter's Order
ccc_north_h1_outfitters_order.body: The next trail party is short on lining and blankets. Bring enough wool to outfit several people before they push farther toward the colder road.

ccc_north_h1_fuel_watch.title: Fuel for the Watch
ccc_north_h1_fuel_watch.body: The watch fires are being kept lit longer as the nights sharpen. Deliver a proper coal reserve so the outer post does not have to choose between warmth and light.

ccc_north_h1_fish_pass.title: Fish for the Pass
ccc_north_h1_fish_pass.body: A climbing party is leaving before dawn and the cook needs food that travels well. Bring enough salmon for the whole group, not just a meal or two.

ccc_north_h1_webs_spruces.title: Webs in the Spruces
ccc_north_h1_webs_spruces.body: Spiders have webbed over the narrow trail between the spruce stands. Clear the nest enough that woodcutters can work without being boxed in after sundown.

ccc_north_h1_leather_snowline.title: Leather for the Snowline
ccc_north_h1_leather_snowline.body: Boots, straps, and pack harness wear quickly once the ground freezes. The outfitter wants a substantial leather stock before the next supply party leaves.

ccc_north_h1_recover_dispatch.title: Dispatch from the Ice
ccc_north_h1_recover_dispatch.body: A missing expedition was last traced to an Ice Pit beyond the safer country. If their dispatch survived, bring it home; the names and route notes matter more than whatever else is in the ruin.

ccc_east_h1_herbalists_basket.title: The Herbalist's Basket
ccc_east_h1_herbalists_basket.body: The drying shelves are nearly empty after a run of remedies. Bring back a worthwhile bundle of cocoa beans so the herbalist can restock before the next caravan arrives.

ccc_east_h1_bamboo_repairs.title: Bamboo Repairs
ccc_east_h1_bamboo_repairs.body: Walkways and garden frames keep failing in the wet. The builder needs a full armload of bamboo to replace the warped sections instead of patching them one at a time.

ccc_east_h1_garden_spiders.title: Something in the Garden
ccc_east_h1_garden_spiders.body: The garden edge has become a hunting ground after dark. Clear the spiders nesting around the beds before the growers lose another row trying to work at dusk.

ccc_east_h1_melons_inn.title: Melons for the Inn
ccc_east_h1_melons_inn.body: A wet week stranded more travelers than expected and the kitchen burned through its easy food. Bring enough melon to refill the common table for a few days.

ccc_east_h1_moss_nursery.title: Moss for the Nursery
ccc_east_h1_moss_nursery.body: Young shade plants are drying out faster than the nursery can water them. Fresh moss will hold the damp around the beds; bring enough to cover the new plots properly.

ccc_east_h1_recover_survey_notes.title: Notes from the Green
ccc_east_h1_recover_survey_notes.body: A survey party vanished while documenting a Jungle Monument. Recover their field notes if you find them; the routes, plants, and warnings inside are worth bringing back intact.

ccc_south_h1_dry_country.title: Leather for the Dry Road
ccc_south_h1_dry_country.body: Long roads eat through reins, packs, boots, and waterskin straps. The outfitter is building a reserve before the next caravan leaves for the hotter country.

ccc_south_h1_dry_road.title: Dead on the Dry Road
ccc_south_h1_dry_road.body: Husks have begun lingering near the road markers after sunset. Reduce the pack before a caravan is forced off the marked route in the dark.

ccc_south_h1_caravan_rations.title: Caravan Rations
ccc_south_h1_caravan_rations.body: A long-haul caravan is leaving with more people than expected. Bring enough bread to provision the group rather than sending them out counting every loaf.

ccc_south_h1_cactus_packers.title: Cactus for the Packers
ccc_south_h1_cactus_packers.body: The packing crews use cactus for rough travel gear and repairs where greener materials do not last. Bring a proper batch of clean cuttings for the next run.

ccc_south_h1_clay_cistern.title: Seal the Cistern
ccc_south_h1_clay_cistern.body: The village cistern is losing water through old cracks. The mason wants enough clay to seal the weak sections before the dry stretch turns a leak into a problem.

ccc_south_h1_recover_tomb_tablet.title: The Buried Record
ccc_south_h1_recover_tomb_tablet.body: A Desert Tomb nearby is said to hold a carved tablet from an older road. Bring the tablet back intact; the writing may identify routes and ruins farther into Sunscar.

ccc_south_h1_flowers_savanna.title: Flowers of the Savanna
ccc_south_h1_flowers_savanna.body: The botanist is cultivating acacia stock for elephant keepers. Bring healthy young acacias and the village will trade you the blossoms used to befriend the great herds.

ccc_west_h1_pest_keeping.title: Root Cellar Stock
ccc_west_h1_pest_keeping.body: The root cellar is thinner than it should be this early in the season. Bring a real basket of potatoes so the village can put food away instead of eating through seed stock.

ccc_west_h1_crow_granary.title: Seed for the Granary
ccc_west_h1_crow_granary.body: The granary keeper separated too little seed from the last harvest. Bring enough wheat seed to refill the planting bins before good grain gets eaten by mistake.

ccc_west_h1_chime_dusk.title: Phantoms Over the Eaves
ccc_west_h1_chime_dusk.body: Phantoms have started circling the roofs on sleepless nights. Bring the number down before people begin avoiding the streets after dark altogether.

ccc_west_h1_woodmans_order.title: Timber for the Sawmill
ccc_west_h1_woodmans_order.body: Barn repairs and autumn work have emptied the sawmill yard. Bring a full timber load so the carpenter crews can stop rationing every beam.

ccc_west_h1_harvest_supper.title: Harvest Supper
ccc_west_h1_harvest_supper.body: The village is feeding more field hands than usual while the harvest is moving. Bring enough carrots for the common supper, not merely a handful for one pot.

ccc_west_h1_apples_pressing.title: Apples for Pressing
ccc_west_h1_apples_pressing.body: The early wind knocked fruit before the pickers were ready. The orchard keeper is buying good apples for the presses before the fallen crop spoils.

ccc_west_h1_recover_stable_seal.title: The Empty Stables
ccc_west_h1_recover_stable_seal.body: An old roadside stable went silent and nobody has found a clean answer why. Search the place and bring back its Stablemaster's Seal; if it is still there, the village will know which stable was lost.
